subject: [PATCH v6 18/19] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness: pageout and compactor. The pageout thread simulates memory pressure by repeatedly advising a region of memory for swap-out, faults it back in, and checks its contents to ensure that the page's pattern is preserved after being written to disk. The compactor thread writes to /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory in a loop, competing with the collapse for pages and causing refcount elevations and migration entries. Each test run now includes 12 combinations of modes and occupancy limits, including both with and without these new threads.
